title: Workforce management on the day
blurb: Real-time adherence every few seconds, intraday every 15 minutes, and the published schedule.

lessons.title: Two clocks after the schedule exists
lessons.summary: Real-time adherence updates every few seconds. Intraday updates every 15 minutes and can reforecast the rest of the day. Historical adherence is a report.
objectives: Keep history off the live board

p: The Monitor page says that after the forecast and the schedules exist, you monitor both. Real Time Adherence compares scheduled WFM activities with events from the ACD. You can see which agents are in adherence. RTA data updates every few seconds.

Intraday shows the forecast for a skill on a day, the actual data, and the variance. You can reforecast the rest of the day from the actuals and add or remove shifts. Intraday data updates every 15 minutes. Historical adherence is a generated report of past adherence.
The same page lists two setup steps. Establish a connection to the ACD. Then map incoming ACD events to WFM activities.
Without that map, the live comparison does not have a WFM activity to compare. Later lessons use the adherence page for the states. This lesson is only the clocks and the setup.

lessons.title: The live table is only the current state
lessons.summary: RTA shows the current scheduled activity beside the current actual activity. A break that already ended is not on that table. Schedule edits show up almost immediately.
objectives: Ask for the Real Time Adherence permission
Keep past intervals off this table

p: The Real Time Adherence page requires WFM > General Permissions > Real Time Adherence set to ON. The table is a side-by-side of scheduled and actual activities. You only see users in the scheduling units or teams your view allows.
If the employee is on a non-CXone ACD, the ACD Login ID has to be on the employee profile. The page says that ID is what maps the agent state for live adherence and for reports.

sections.h: What the table refuses to show
p: RTA shows the current state and how long it has lasted. A break that ended earlier is not on this table. Earlier intervals and past days belong on the Historical Adherence report.
Changes to schedules or settings show up almost immediately and can flip the status either way. You can filter by agents, scheduling units, WEM skills, scheduled activities, or actual activities.

lessons.title: Activity adherence or category adherence
lessons.summary: A tenant uses one approach. If the category columns are on the table, adherence compares categories. Otherwise it compares activities. The page prints both examples.

p: The Real Time Adherence page says adherence is either activity-based or category-based, and only one is active. If Scheduled category and Actual category columns are visible, the tenant is category-based. If they are not, it is activity-based.
Actual Activity is the ACD event mapped to a WFM activity. The map is the second setup step from the Monitor page.
Activity example: scheduled On call and actual On call is in adherence. Scheduled On call and actual Break is out of adherence.
Category example: scheduled OutboundChat and actual Outbound, both in WorkHours, is in adherence. Scheduled OutboundChat in WorkHours and actual Break in CategoryBreak is out of adherence.

lessons.title: Out of adherence, open, and severe
lessons.summary: Severe out of adherence is the headset icon: scheduled open, actual not open. Open versus a different open activity is out of adherence and OOA Open, but not severe.
objectives: Name when adherence is not calculated
Keep severe for the non-open actual

p: In adherence means the agent is doing the scheduled activity. Out of adherence means they are not. The page's table: scheduled Break and actual Open is out of adherence only. Scheduled Open and actual Break is out of adherence, OOA Open, and Severe. Scheduled Open and actual Outbound_Open is out of adherence and OOA Open, not Severe.

Severe is the headset icon. It means the agent was scheduled to be open for interactions and the actual activity is not open. OOA Open without severe means both activities are open, but they are different open activities.
Not calculated means the system cannot say. The page's cases include an actual activity that is not mapped, and an agent who is not working and has no schedule, such as out of office.

Adherence is calculated when the agent has an active schedule and is logged in, moving between states. If one side has an adherence category and the other does not, the agent is out of adherence. If both categories are missing and the activities differ, the agent is also out of adherence.

lessons.title: Green dots, yellow dots, and 36 months
lessons.summary: A generated schedule remembers which forecast or staffing file it used. Green means published for all skills. Yellow means specific skills. Schedule Manager purges data older than 36 months.
objectives: Filter by a scheduling unit first

p: Schedule Manager reviews and edits the schedule WFM generated from the staffing plan you created or uploaded in forecasting. You can also build a schedule from scratch, or from shift bidding. The Forecast/Staffing Name column shows which forecast or imported staffing plan was used. Not Available can mean the forecast was deleted after generation or was never used. A staffing plan file uses a .CSV extension so you can tell it from a forecast.
Publish when the shifts are ready. A view assigned to the scheduler limits which scheduling units they can see.
On the calendar, a green dot means the schedule is published for all skills. A yellow dot means specific skills. Hover a yellow dot for the skill list. Weekly and Daily views show the same dots.

Select a scheduling unit before you filter by skill, group, or activity. The page's example starts with 100 agents in three units, filters to one unit and sees 30, then filters to one skill and sees 15. Those counts are the example, not a product limit. Data older than 36 months is purged. The day grid starts one hour before the earliest configured start. In the page's Monday example the earliest start is 5:00 AM, so the view is positioned at 4:00 AM using UTC+08:00.

lessons.title: Fix the live row from Schedule Manager
lessons.summary: If the agent should be on break, change the activity in Schedule Manager and publish. RTA updates almost immediately. The CSV export covers up to 30 days and leaves unmapped activities uncalculated.

p: The Real Time Adherence page says you can put the agent back in adherence by editing the current activity in Schedule Manager and publishing. The example is changing the activity to break. The change shows in RTA and in the adherence report.
RTA still will not show the earlier activities. The historical report is where a finished break belongs.
You can export a historical adherence CSV for the selected scheduling units. The page says the raw data covers the past 30 days, and a single export can span up to 30 days.
Unmapped activities are written as Unmapped. Adherence is not calculated for them. That matches the not-calculated state on the live table.
